definitions.explanation: The natural features of an area viewed as a whole.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}からの{景色|けしき}がきれいだった。
examples.english: The scenery from the mountain was beautiful.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{海|うみ}の{景色|けしき}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see the ocean view from the window.

notes:
Similar words:
- {景色|けしき} - scenery, landscape (natural)
- {風景|ふうけい} - scenery, landscape (more formal)
- {眺め|ながめ} - view (what you see from a specific point)
